project: Directional organelle-dynamics platform (organellomics; Hickey/Nazarov/Smertenko Plant Physiol 2023) — vertical #3 ENDOPLASMIC RETICULUM
design_note: Directional score = biogenesis module score - degradation(ER-phagy) module score, plus a SELECTIVE degradation sub-score built only from the ER-selective receptor genes Atg39/Atg40. Like the mitochondrion vertical (Atg32) and unlike the peroxisome plant transfer (no ATG36 ortholog), ER-phagy HAS genuine selective receptors (Atg39 perinuclear/nuclear-ER; Atg40 cortical ER; Mochida 2015 Nature), so the SELECTIVE degradation arm is populated and testable here — another closed-arm case demonstrating the clearance arm is trustworthy when a real receptor exists.

biogenesis.GO:0006614: SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane
biogenesis.GO:0031204: posttranslational protein targeting to membrane, translocation

degradation.GO:0006914: macroautophagy (bulk — flags shared core autophagy machinery)

resolver_services.gene_resolution: mygene.info via genes-ontologies MCP (query_genes; scopes=symbol,alias; species=559292; SGD systematic + Swiss-Prot returned)
resolver_services.go_membership: QuickGO get_go_annotations (genes-ontologies MCP); per-gene distinct GO IDs intersected with the seed ER term set to CONFIRM membership rather than hand-assign

selective_arm_design: degradation_selective_ids = ATG39 (YLR312C) + ATG40 (YOR152C), the two ER-phagy receptors with shared_with_bulk_autophagy=False. Both carry GO:0061709 (reticulophagy). This is the ER analogue of Atg32/Atg33 in the mitochondrion vertical — a genuine selective-receptor arm, in contrast to the empty pexophagy arm of the Arabidopsis peroxisome transfer.
collision_and_qc_flags: SBH1 (YER087C-B): mygene 'name' field returns 'Arf family guanine nucleotide exchange factor' — a mislabel. SBH1 is the Sec61 beta subunit; systematic ID YER087C-B and GO:0006616/GO:0031204 (translocon) confirm the correct identity. Kept as translocon; name annotation flagged.
OST2 (YOR103C) and SWP1/OST6/WBP1 mygene names truncate to generic 'glycotransferase' strings; systematic IDs and GO:0008250 (OST complex) confirm identity.

dropped_genes.HAC1 (YFL031W): UPR effector transcription factor (bZIP). Its mRNA is regulated by IRE1-mediated splicing, not by abundance, and it is a lineage-specific transcriptional regulator, not conserved structural biogenesis machinery. Dropped per the cross-taxa / regulator rule established in the peroxisome and mitochondrion verticals (which dropped PEX regulators and HAP2/3/4/5). IRE1 — the conserved ER-membrane sensor kinase/RNase — is retained as machinery.

mrna_proxy_caveat: Transcript abundance is a proxy. A positive net_direction is 'consistent with a shift toward ER biogenesis/expansion'; elevated degradation/selective scores are 'consistent with a shift toward ER clearance (ER-phagy)'. These are NOT organelle turnover rates. Additionally, ER 'abundance' is a fuzzier concept than a countable organelle — the ER is a continuous membrane network, so module scores index the biosynthetic/clearance PROGRAM, not a copy number.
literature_verification_note: Atg39/Atg40 as ER-phagy receptors confirmed via PubMed (Mochida et al., Nature 2015, PMID 26040717).

positive_controls_validation_results.method: CPM-normalized then method='zscore', n_perm=2000; rank cross-check agrees on direction
positive_controls_validation_results.coverage: 29/29 biogenesis, 10/10 ER-phagy, 2/2 Atg39/Atg40-selective in both datasets
